Free Spins Terms and Conditions

2.1. For offers that provide free spins or other rewards after a certain period following the qualifying deposit (e.g. the 180 free spins in the Welcome Offer), the qualifying deposit must be wagered at least once to meet the offer requirements. 2.5. Once your free spins have been activated you must complete all game rounds within 1 days otherwise they will expire.

2.6. BitStarz reserves the right to cancel or amend these terms & conditions at any point without any prior notice.

First 20 are credited right after your first deposit, and then 20 more 24 hours later. This will go on for 8 straight days until you get a total of 180 free spins. Please note, cancelling any part of the welcome free spins at any stage prior to completion, will forfeit the remaining free spins.

General Bonus Terms and Conditions

3.1. All customer offers are limited to one per person, family, household address, email address, telephone number, same payment account number (e.g. debit or credit card, Neteller etc), IP, or shared computer, e.g. public library or workplace.

3.2.1. We reserve the right to not pay players using disposable email addresses

3.2.2. Players from the following countries are not eligible for the welcome package, unless stated otherwise in the Promotion rules: Slovenia (SI), Croatia (HR), Bosnia and Herzegovina (BA), Republic of North Macedonia (MK), Montenegro (ME), Austria (AT), Kosovo (XK) and Finland (FI).

3.2.3. We reserve the right to lower the percentage of the Monday Reload bonus to a 25% bonus for players who we deem have received an un-proportionate level of bonuses based on their bonus release to deposit ratio. Furthermore, we reserve the right to exclude players entirely from receiving bonuses at our sole discretion. The Monday Reload bonus is added to your first qualifying deposit of the day.

3.3. You can utilize different parts of the welcome package in various currencies. For example, you can claim the first deposit bonus in euros and the second deposit bonus in bitcoin.

3.4. All bonuses (unless otherwise specified) need to be wagered 40 (forty) times before the funds can be withdrawn.

3.5. Bonus funds cannot be used on certain games due to specific game mechanics. Games with progressive jackpots or accumulating mechanics are excluded from contributing to bonus wagering requirements. Additional games may also be restricted at our discretion.

Table games, live games, instant-win games, lotteries, and bingo typically contribute 5% towards wagering requirements. Any applicable contribution rates or exclusions are automatically managed by our systems to ensure compliance with bonus policies.

Please note that the list of excluded games is dynamic and may change as new games are released, updated, or identified for restrictions.

In case a game is not available with bonus funds a message will appear on the screen when entering the game. But for assistance with bonus restrictions or questions regarding specific games, please contact customer support.

3.6. Players may request a withdrawal of their deposited funds before fulfilling the bonus wagering requirements. However, the bonus must first be cancelled, and in doing so, the bonus amount and all associated winnings will be forfeited. This is because winnings are tied to the bonus. Additionally, please note that when playing with an active bonus, deposited funds (real money) are used before the bonus funds.

3.7. All bonuses that are a part of the Welcome Package are valid for 7 days. All other bonuses (unless otherwise stated) will expire after 24 hours from being issued.

3.8. Bonus funds and any winnings accumulated while using the bonus will be forfeited if the bonus expires or is cancelled.

3.9. When betting, placed bets are deducted from the player's cash balance. However, if no cash balance is available the bet placed will be deducted from the player's bonus balance.

3.10. Until the playthrough requirements have been met, the maximum allowable bet with a bonus active is 5 EUR/USD/CAD/AUD/NZD/USDT, 50 kr, ¥500, 0.01 BCH, 0.05 LTC, 0.0015 ETH, 25 DOGE or 0.00006 BTC.

This restriction also applies to double-up wagers after a game round has been completed (e.g., wagering winnings from a game round on red/black) and in-game bonus features that can be purchased like "bonus-buys".

3.11. Any bonus may be cancelled before fulfilling the wagering requirements. Players have the option to remove their bonus by contacting BitStarz support or by using the "Cancel" button on their bonus found under "My Rewards and Prizes." Please be aware that choosing to cancel the bonus will lead to the forfeiture of both the bonus amount and any associated winnings.

3.12.1. Only one promotional offer can be claimed at a time (Excluding Bonuz Mania). Deposit bonuses cannot be stacked.

3.12.2. BitStarz management reserves the right to void any bonuses and/or winnings obtained through fraudulent behavior.

3.13. Any "free spin" or "bonus" winnings resulting from bonus funds after the bonus has been wagered, lost or forfeited shall be removed.

Only fully settled bets (i.e. bets that result in a win or loss) will be counted towards wagering.

3.16. Multiple accounts are not permitted. Creating more than one accounts with BitStarz in order to claim any bonuses is deemed as bonus abuse and may result in confiscated funds.

3.17. Bonus round and free spins do not qualify for the jackpot bonuses pursuant to casino software provider rules. Only real money rounds qualify for the jackpot bonuses.

3.18. Minimal risk bets on any games (i.e. betting in proportions on different outcomes in the same hand to create "action" with minimal risk) do not qualify for completing the wagering requirement. Examples of minimal risk bets include betting on red and black simultaneously in Roulette, and betting player and banker simultaneously in Baccarat.
